title: Add 'All Lights' control
description: Implement functionality to control all lights simultaneously, including an 'All Off' command in the CLI and TUI.
close_reason: Implemented 'All Lights' control in both CLI ('set all') and TUI ('ALL LIGHTS' entry).

title: Show device status (on/off/level) in listing
description: Update the 'list devices' command and TUI to show the current status (on/off and brightness level) for each device.

title: Develop Lit Web UI
description: Build a modern web dashboard using Lit WebComponents to control the Lutron system via the CLI's server mode.

title: Explore Sonos discovery and control
description: Investigate SSDP/UPNP discovery and control protocols for Sonos devices to integrate them into the CLI/TUI.

title: Scaffold Cobra CLI
description: Set up a Go CLI using Cobra with commands for 'discover', 'list' (devices/areas), and 'set' (level/status).
close_reason: Implemented 'list areas' and 'list devices' commands using the core LEAP client.

title: Investigate Go-native mDNS for Lutron discovery
description: Determine if Go can handle the Lutron mDNS discovery process natively to remove the Python bootstrap dependency.

title: Implement CLI Server Mode
description: Add a 'serve' command to the CLI that starts an HTTP/WebSocket server to proxy LEAP commands to the bridge.

title: Add per-area view to TUI
description: Implement a hierarchical or filtered view in the TUI to browse devices by area.

title: Explore Lifx discovery and control
description: Investigate discovery and control protocols for Lifx smart bulbs to integrate them into the CLI/TUI.

title: Build Bubble Tea TUI
description: Interactive TUI now supports device control (dimming) via keys 1-9, 0, and +.

title: Obtain Lutron Bridge Certificates
description: Perform the pairing process with the Lutron Smart Bridge (192.168.4.90) to obtain the unique TLS client certificate and private key required for LEAP communication.
close_reason: Successfully paired with the bridge and obtained TLS certificates: lutron_ca.crt, lutron_client.crt, and lutron_client.key.

title: Evaluate Go SDK for Lutron LEAP
description: Assess the 'n67/leap' or 'the-mace/lutron-leap-go' libraries for implementing a controller in Go, using the obtained certificates.
close_reason: Successfully verified that a Go implementation using standard 'crypto/tls' can connect and communicate with the bridge using the paired certificates. While third-party SDKs are sparse, direct LEAP over TLS is straightforward to implement in Go.

title: Implement core Go LEAP client
description: Create a robust Go package to handle LEAP protocol messaging, including JSON serialization for commands like GET /device, GET /area, and POST /zone/status.
close_reason: Basic LEAP client package implemented in pkg/leap with TLS and ReadRequest support.
